comparison.caveat: Descriptive paired difference (treatment minus baseline), 10000 seeded bootstrap samples of family clusters. Repeated attempts are averaged within case. The evaluated templated families are a small correlated sample; the interval does not establish population capability. Configured-system comparisons can vary model and effort together and cannot establish a pure effort effect. Clean contrasts exclude output truncation.

scope: Three matched development cases; one attempt per model; both high effort. Zero observed native/diagnostic difference is not population equivalence. Shared eligibility failure and correlated criteria; extracted-response phase/block attribution unresolved. No causal cross-generation difficulty or professional-validity claim.
